title: Quantum-JEPA: Quantum Born Priors for Latent-Action JEPA World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. tldr: 提出了Quantum-JEPA框架，通过条件量子玻恩先验与潜在动作机制学习未来表征的分布，使世界模型能够捕捉多种可能的未来情景，并在D3IL基准上从同一起点生成多条跨越障碍的路线。
